text: Age: 45
Occupation: Founder & CEO
Twenty-five years ago, while walking down Pico Blvd, as an undocumented teenager, I was inspired by a bus ad for Santa Monica College; I enrolled soon after.
That decision changed the trajectory of my life. SMC opened a door that led to a doctorate and over twenty years of service to Los Angeles County nonprofits and communities.
I was appointed to the SMC Board of Trustees in February 2025, since then I have focused on:
Student success. Every student deserves a real path to transfer, a career, or lifelong learning.
Career pathways. Partnerships with future employers so students graduate into good jobs.
Transparency. I've published my board votes online, alongside every trustee's, so residents can see how decisions are made.

Community colleges are where working families, immigrants, veterans, and where people starting over can have a second chance. I have lived that. I commit to keep SMC affordable, accountable, and open to all.
Endorsed by Assemblymember Mike Fong (Chair, Assembly Higher Education Committee), Mayor Caroline Torosis, and SMC Trustees Nancy Greenstein, Rob Rader, and Anastasia Foster.

text: My own path to higher education was not a traditional one. I attended community college in Belize, immigrated to the United States, and returned to school as an adult learner; earning my bachelor's degree after age 35 and my master's after 40, while raising my family and building my business. That journey taught me that every student's path is different, and every student deserves the opportunity to succeed.

As Executive Director of the Santa Monica Black Empowerment Association, I have worked directly with hundreds of individuals and families, connecting them to housing, workforce development, and education resources. I founded the Empower Her Entrepreneurial Program, writing the curriculum myself and personally taught 3 cohorts and helped twenty seven women to build their own businesses.
I am also a small business owner, a certified life coach, and President of SMC Associates.

As your Trustee, I will bring collaborative leadership, fiscal responsibility, and sound judgment to the Board. I will listen, ask thoughtful questions, and work to keep Santa Monica College accessible, affordable, and responsive to every student; from those arriving straight from high school to those returning later in life, as I did.
